_about: 60 synthetic application emails for the application-mail rules (tests/test_application_mail_eval.py). Every company, person, and address is invented. Each label was written on 2026-09-27 from the email alone, before the rules were run on the set, using inbox_classifiers.EMAIL_QUESTION v2: the first kind that applies in the order offer, rejected, interview, assessment, scheduling, application_confirmation, deadline, recruiter_reply, unknown. bulk marks a mailing-list email (List-Unsubscribe). trusted_employer marks mail from a company domain the student has trusted. note says why a hard one got its label.
